title: Policy
description:
A `.zitadel/policies/<operation>.json` file: the policy of one operation, as
`zitadel deploy` carries it in the release bundle. It has the same shape as a
publish request (`POST /policies`).

`operation` selects the operation's template and `config` sets its settings.
A setting left out is off, and `{}` switches every rule off. The file is named
after its `operation`.

$schema.description: Editor affordance: path or URL of this schema so editors validate and autocomplete the file (policy files point at `.zitadel/meta/policy.json`). Ignored by the platform.

PasswordSetPolicyInput.title: PasswordSetPolicyInput
PasswordSetPolicyInput.description: A publish of the password policy, checked before a password is set.

PasswordSetConfig.title: PasswordSetPolicyConfig
PasswordSetConfig.description:
The settings of an `auth.factor.password.set` policy. Every setting is
optional; a setting left out switches its rule off, and `{}` switches every
rule off. There are no defaults. The bounds are technical limits, not
recommendations; the server's template checks the same bounds.

min_length.description:
The fewest Unicode code points a new password may have, counted after
NFC normalization. At most `max_length` when both are set.

max_length.description:
The most Unicode code points a new password may have. A password above
64 code points is refused whether or not this is set.

history_depth.description:
How many of the user's passwords a new one may not repeat, the current
one included. Checked only when users set their own password.
